import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "gae_lambda": 0.95}


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
GD = 64

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16}

        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.gproj = nn.Linear(gdim, proj)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f, g):
        p = self.proj(f) + self.gproj(g)[:, :, None, None]
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)

            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)

    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, GD), nn.ReLU())
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH + COL, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID, GD)
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(GD, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(GD, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 32
P = 16
HID = 16

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 3, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16}


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.lay_local = nn.Conv2d(12, P, 1)
        self.lay_col = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH + COL, P, 1)
        self.lay_emb = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(self.Z, P))
        self.lay2 = nn.Conv2d(P, P, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * P, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        Y = obs.shape[2]
        X = obs.shape[3]
        Z = self.Z
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        vox = obs[:, :4 * Z].reshape(B, 4, Z, Y, X)
        vp = F.pad(vox, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1))
        loc = torch.cat([vp[:, :, 0:Z], vp[:, :, 1:Z + 1], vp[:, :, 2:Z + 2]], dim=1)
        loc = loc.permute(0, 2, 1, 3, 4).reshape(B * Z, 12, Y, X)
        a = self.lay_local(loc).view(B, Z, P, Y, X)
        c = self.lay_col(torch.cat([f, s], dim=1)).unsqueeze(1)
        e = self.lay_emb.view(1, Z, P, 1, 1)
        h = F.relu(a + c + e).reshape(B * Z, P, Y, X)
        p = self.lay2(h)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            sc = out(F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1))))
            sc = sc.reshape(B, Z, Y * X)
            res.append(torch.logsumexp(sc, dim=1))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
HEADS = 4
PROJ = 32
HID = 32

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "gae_lambda": 0.95}


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(WIDTH)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(WIDTH, 3 * WIDTH)
        self.o = nn.Linear(WIDTH, WIDTH)
        self.ln2 = nn.LayerNorm(WIDTH)
        self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(WIDTH, 2 * WIDTH), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, WIDTH))
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        Y = obs.shape[2]
        X = obs.shape[3]
        N = Y * X
        dh = WIDTH // HEADS
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        t = f.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        h = self.ln1(t)
        q, k, v = self.qkv(h).chunk(3, dim=-1)
        q = q.reshape(B, N, HEADS, dh).transpose(1, 2)
        k = k.reshape(B, N, HEADS, dh).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.reshape(B, N, HEADS, dh).transpose(1, 2)
        att = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(2, 3)) / math.sqrt(dh), dim=-1)
        a = torch.matmul(att, v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, WIDTH)
        t = t + self.o(a)
        t = t + self.ff(self.ln2(t))
        f2 = t.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, WIDTH, Y, X)
        place = self.head(f2)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f2.mean((2, 3)), f2.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
GD = 64

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.005}


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid, gdim):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.gproj = nn.Linear(gdim, proj)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(hid, hid, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1)) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f, g):
        p = self.proj(f) + self.gproj(g)[:, :, None, None]
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix in zip(self.fps, self.mix):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            res.append(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, GD), nn.ReLU())
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH + COL, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID, GD)
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(GD, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(GD, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        place = self.head(torch.cat([f, s], dim=1), g)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.2: All three round-1 trials trained without errors, but every score is hidden, so I have no measured evidence to rank them, and I won't get any later either. The final pick uses the real 2-seed dev scores across all trials, so the aim is to make the best trial as good as possible rather than to isolate effects. Reasoning from the task: footprints are at most 2x2, so a 5x5 receptive field is enough locally. The hard part is the landing-layer logic (the highest column under the footprint versus the target at that layer), plus knowing when to stop. Three bets: (1) the column-skip head with a deeper footprint mixer, (2) a stronger version of the per-layer scoring that scores each possible landing layer, (3) global self-attention to help ordering and DONE. All three use 2 PPO epochs and 128 envs, so they get more samples and more updates. Two of them raise gamma so the +1 exact-build bonus counts for more.
analyses.3: All six trials trained without errors, but every score is hidden, so I can't rank them. I chose the next trials by reasoning about the task. Building exactly needs three things. First, exact facts per footprint: the landing layer is the maximum height under the footprint, and every cell at that layer must be missing from the build. Second, enough of the design in view to choose build order. Third, enough samples. r2c1 brings together the plausible gains so far: clean column features, global context, a deeper footprint scorer and more samples. I use it as the base and change one thing per trial. (1) Receptive field: one dilated residual conv, a cheap 2D alternative to attention. (2) Sample count: 1 PPO epoch, which gives about 1.8x the samples. (3) A new head: it concatenates the exact features of each cell under the footprint instead of min/max/avg pooling them, so cell-by-cell facts are kept.
analyses.4: I can't see any scores, so I can't say which trial is best. The only evidence is that all 9 trials trained without errors, and that r3c2 shows a small network can run about 365k steps within the time limit. The remaining choices therefore rest on reasoning about the task. A brick placement is exact only if every cell under its footprint tops out at the same layer and the target is missing a cell at that layer in every one of them. The r3c3 head keeps each footprint cell separate, so it can learn this rule directly; pooling over the footprint loses which cell is which. Fresh random designs make more samples (1 epoch) a plausible gain for generalising to unseen designs, and wider context helps with build order. In this last round I combine these likely-good parts in different ways, which raises the chance that one 2-seed score beats the starting architecture. I don't change anything that is risky for the checks or the time limit.
